package: K35-T2 recover Studio completion after committed storage object and lost response

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped after test
result.scenario: The loopback fixture is placed in the post-commit/lost-response state: the valid object exists and the multipart UploadId is gone while the database row still says UPLOADING.
assertions: cross-channel complete is rejected with 404 before storage access
authorized retry receives NoSuchUpload, verifies the already-present object and returns HTTP 200
original becomes READY and exactly one encode job is created
the real scripts/video-worker.ts encodes that recovered object and the job becomes SUCCEEDED

limitations: Lost response is represented by preparing the exact post-commit storage/DB state, not by forcibly severing a network connection to real R2.
Storage and worker use a loopback S3-shaped fixture; no Cloudflare R2 or deployed Worker was contacted.
This covers one crash boundary only; broader K35 role/state/retry matrix and independent review remain open.
